name: Marcos Ros Sempere - Après le § 6 - Am 3
title: REPORT on a new strategy for media literacy and digital learning
part_text: 6a. Further emphasises that the EU cannot present itself as the guarantor of democracy in the Member States while measures such as the withholding of EU funds, non-transparent negotiation processes, the application of unequal standards between Member States or the communication surrounding such measures may influence domestic political debates and electoral processes; stresses that all actions undertaken by EU institutions should fully respect the principles of transparency, equal treatment, institutional neutrality and democratic self-determination of Member States;
